Appeal No. Z36086 heard by the Board of Variance on October 24, 2023, & ALLOWED, thereby granting a relaxation of the Minimum Site Area regulations of the RT-2 District Schedule and approved the construction of a new two-family dwelling (Duplex) at 1374 Cartier Place, and subject to the following conditions:

An extension request was reviewed by the Board of Variance on September 08, 2026 and a further TWO (2) years extension was APPROVED, thereby extending the previous Board of Variance decision, and subject to the following conditions:

(1) that the final form of development (final design) shall be to the satisfaction of the Director of Planning; and
(2) that the development shall otherwise comply with the requirements and regulations of the Zoning and Development By-law to the satisfaction of the Director of Planning.  

Note: This is a 2 storey building pursuant to the Zoning and Development By-Law

1.\tHRV unit proposed - located in second floor hallway closet
2.\tHeat pump proposed – Exterior component located in rear yard
3.\tBar sink located in REC RM
4.\tSchedule B: (X.L. Chen) P.Eng (778.235.5447) Structural & Geotechnical
5.\tHPO: Residential Builder- Boyoung Group Homes Ltd.

Address Information:

EAST UNIT
#1-1374 Cartier Pl  - Principal Dwelling (East side 1st-2nd floors)

WEST UNIT
#2-1374 Cartier Pl  - Principal Dwelling (West side 1st-2nd floors) 

Address and suite numbers assigned as per approved plans for Fire and Emergency response. The address numbers are to be posted on the building to be visible from the street and the suite numbers are to be posted at the suite entries in accordance with the Building By-law prior to final inspection.
